text:
maya: Running the python quickstart inside a docker container. First SDK call errors with 402 even though the org has credits. Error text: "payment_required:workspace_requires_billing". Anyone seen the python SDK behave weird in containers?

josh: Do you use a user key or a service account? Docker image might be picking up an old env var during build.

maya: Using service account key mounted at /secrets/redwood.key and setting REDWOOD_API_KEY in docker run. Example code: `client = Redwood(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])\nresp = client.generate("hello")`

billing-bot: Automated audit: token_type=service_account, workspace=W789, billing_status=active, policy_block=terms_pending, terms_link=https://console.redwood.example/orgs/W789/terms

tina: Looks like the console accepted billing but not the new service-account terms flag. We added that for headless tokens last quarter.

maya: Strange — I explicitly accepted terms as admin for the org yesterday. Could the SDK be hitting a different workspace ID?

josh: Can you `print(client.whoami())` or `GET /v1/workspaces/me` with the token from inside the container to confirm workspace id? Old SDKs sometimes include X-Redwood-Org header when REDWOOD_ORG was set at build time.

maya: Ran `GET /v1/workspaces/me` and got W790, not W789. Oops — my CI image has a baked-in env var REDWOOD_ORG=W790 from an older project. The team copy/pasted the Dockerfile.

devex-bot: Tip: avoid baking credentials or org IDs into images. Use runtime secrets or docker secrets, and double-check `REDWOOD_ORG` is unset to prevent accidental routing.

tina: Two fixes: 1) unset REDWOOD_ORG in the container env and re-run 2) admin for W790 needs to accept terms or swap to the correct workspace.

maya: Unset REDWOOD_ORG and retried — now 200 OK. First-call success from inside docker. Thanks!

josh: Filing a small docs PR for the python quickstart to call out the REDWOOD_ORG / baked-env pitfall plus a note about headless token term acceptance.

maya: Also: can the SDK error be clearer? `payment_required:terms_pending` + a console link would have pointed me straight to the issue.

tina: Agree. I'll add a request to the SDK team backlog to include a `terms_pending` subcode and admin url in the response for service-account gating.

maya: Saved me ~45 minutes. Closing — will link the docs PR when it's up. :thumbsup:
